# 🌍 Plot 1: Sample Design and map

```{r map_setup}

# Convert and enrich points
ohia_points <- meta_data %>%
  filter(shortname == "Ohia", island == "Oahu") %>%
  filter(!is.na(coord_x) & !is.na(coord_y)) %>%
  mutate(
    lon = coord_y,
    lat = coord_x,
    elevation_m = elevation_ft * 0.3048
  )

# Convert to sf points
ohia_sf <- ohia_points %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Build ridge tracks
ridge_lines <- ohia_points %>%
  arrange(sample_site, elevation_m) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_split(sample_site) %>%
  map(~ {
    coords <- dplyr::select(.x, lon, lat) %>% as.matrix()
    st_linestring(coords)
  })

ridge_groups <- ohia_points %>%
  arrange(sample_site, elevation_m) %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_split(sample_site)

ridge_names <- ohia_points %>%
  arrange(sample_site, elevation_m) %>%
  pull(sample_site) %>%
  raster::unique()

ridge_lines <- ridge_groups %>%
  map(~ {
    coords <- dplyr::select(.x, lon, lat) %>% as.matrix()
    st_linestring(coords)
  })

ohia_tracks <- st_sf(
  sample_site = ridge_names,
  geometry = st_sfc(ridge_lines),
  crs = 4326
)

# Start and end elevation labels
elev_labels <- ohia_points %>%
  group_by(sample_site) %>%
  filter(elevation_m == min(elevation_m) | elevation_m == max(elevation_m)) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(round(elevation_m), " m")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Load Hawaiʻi outline
hawaii_outline <- ne_states(country = "United States of America", returnclass = "sf") %>%
  filter(name == "Hawaii")

# Use bounding box from the island outline directly and buffer it
bbox_raw <- st_bbox(hawaii_outline)
bbox_raw[c("xmin", "ymin")] <- bbox_raw[c("xmin", "ymin")] - 0.1
bbox_raw[c("xmax", "ymax")] <- bbox_raw[c("xmax", "ymax")] + 0.1
bbox_sf <- st_as_sf(st_as_sfc(bbox_raw))


# Define paths
elev_path <- here::here("output", "oahu_elevation_z10.tif")
clipped_path <- here::here("output", "oahu_elevation_clipped.tif")

# Load clipped raster if it exists
if (file.exists(clipped_path)) {
  elev_clipped <- raster::raster(clipped_path)

} else {
  # Step 1: Load or download raw elevation
  if (file.exists(elev_path)) {
    elev <- raster::raster(elev_path)
  } else {
    elev <- get_elev_raster(locations = bbox_sf, z = 10, clip = "bbox")
    writeRaster(elev, elev_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  }

  # Step 2: Clip to Oʻahu outline
  elev_clipped <- crop(elev, hawaii_outline) %>%
    raster::mask(hawaii_outline)
  # Ensure elevation values are non-negative
  elev_clipped[elev_clipped < 0] <- 0

  # Step 3: Save clipped raster
  writeRaster(elev_clipped, clipped_path, overwrite = TRUE)
}

# Raster to df for plotting
elev_df <- as.data.frame(rasterToPoints(elev_clipped))
colnames(elev_df) <- c("x", "y", "elevation")
summary(elev_df$elevation)

# Final plot
map <- ggplot() +
  # elevation background
  geom_tile(data = elev_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black", guide = "none") +
  new_scale_fill() + 
  # outline and ridges
  geom_sf(data = hawaii_outline, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = ohia_tracks, aes(color = sample_site), linewidth = 1.2) +
  # elevation labels
  geom_label_repel(
    data = elev_labels,
    aes(x = coord_y, y = coord_x, label = label),
    #stat = "sf_coordinates",
    size = 3,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    seed = 42,
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
    segment.color = "black",
    segment.size = 0.55,
    min.segment.length = 0.1,
    label.size = 0.2,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    force = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_npg() +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-158.3, -157.6), ylim = c(21.25, 21.71), expand = FALSE) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "tl", which_north = "true",
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
  labs(title = "ʻŌhiʻa Ridge Sampling Tracks on Oʻahu", color = "Ridge",
       x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

map
```

Figure 1.: Ridge sampling tracks across Oʻahu, Hawaiʻi. Sampling tracks (colored by ridge) represent arthropod eDNA collections from Metrosideros polymorpha (ʻōhiʻa) along five elevation gradients. Base elevation was derived from a digital elevation model clipped to Oʻahu's outline, with values normalized to start at sea level. Labels indicate the minimum and maximum elevation of each ridge transect (in meters). Map elements include scale bar and north arrow for orientation. scale bar and north arrow for orientation.
